observations: Photo 0 shows a large rectangular solar panel with a dark glass surface and grid lines; no visible brand/model label.
Photo 1 shows another view of the same type of solar panel; still no readable nameplate/specs.
Seller text mentions batteries/inverters/solar panels, but the photos provided appear to show only solar panels (not a battery or inverter).
No visible watt rating, voltage, cell type, or serial/model number on the panel in the photos.

claims.evidence: Photos show solar panels, not a battery.
No battery capacity test, load test, or battery shown in photos.
No battery shown; no inspection/traceable history provided.
Photos do not show specs (wattage, efficiency, warranty) or a label to verify quality.

risks.risk: Wattage/size is unknown; price depends heavily on panel rating (e.g., 100W vs 200W+).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the panel label/nameplate showing watt rating (W), voltage (Vmp/Voc), current (Imp/Isc), and model/serial.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown/standard used-or-uncertain spec solar panel (worst case: lower wattage and no warranty).

risks.risk: Condition and possible damage (cracks, microcracks, water ingress) are not confirmable from these angles.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the frame edges, glass surface (especially corners), and junction box; plus a photo of the backsheet/backs.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially damaged/untested (worst case: reduced performance).

risks.risk: Seller may be advertising batteries/inverters, but the item shown could be only solar panels; mismatch can lead to wrong purchase.
risks.proof: Confirm the exact item being sold (panel vs battery vs inverter) and quantity; send a photo of the exact product with the same listing text.
risks.if_unproven: Price only for the solar panel shown; do not price as a battery/inverter.

risks.risk: No warranty/brand verification; counterfeit or non-original panels are possible without labels.
risks.proof: Photo of brand/logo and full specifications label; also any warranty card/receipt.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic/unverified brand with no warranty.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of the panel label/nameplate (watt rating and model/serial).
Send close-up photos of the junction box and the four corners/edges of the glass/frame.
Confirm the exact item for sale (solar panel only, or also battery/inverter) and the quantity.
response.reason: The photos show solar panels but provide no readable wattage/model/specs, and the seller’s battery claims are not supported by the images. Without the panel rating/label, a correct worst-case price cannot be determined.
